items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 63:1
items.html: (To the question) What are the additions of Rachel? In the Nukva of ZA, called Rachel, there is only one point in the aspect of permanence, namely from the aspect of the inner vessels, which are no longer diminished after their correction. For the aspect of the ZAT of the smallness of the Nekudim did not come out there except the KHB HGT of the vessels up to the chest, and the point of the chest was their Malchut, which from the aspect of the lights are discerned as HGT NHY, and the crown of the Yesod is their Malchut, as is known, by the inverse relation between the vessels and the lights. And at the time of the correction of the ZAT in Atzilut, only these vessels of the smallness of the Nekudim could be corrected permanently, which are discerned as the inner vessels, namely the KHB HGT up to the chest, for ZA, and the point of the chest for Malchut. But from the aspect of the vessels from the chest and below of the Nekudim, which came out at the time of their greatness, although from them too are clarified and corrected in Atzilut for the need of the ZON, being all the Mochin of his GAR, nevertheless they are not in him permanently, but ascend and descend according to the deeds of the lower ones, as is known. Therefore everything that comes out in ZA beyond the aforementioned VAK, and in the Nukva beyond the point of her Keter, is called an addition, and is not essential in them, for it is not in them permanently.
